fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (2861 Tremont Rd) pointed at a mixed industrial area ~2.5 km away with no gypsum plant. Actual GP Gypsum Savannah is at 151 Wahlstrom Road, Savannah GA 31404 on the Savannah River, ~1.13 mi downstream of the Talmadge Bridge. Confirmed via Georgia EPD permit narrative and business listings; locked center ~32.0770,-81.0525.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Plant approached by a long private industrial access road (Wahlstrom Rd) off the public network; controlled-access industrial site. Street View shows perimeter fencing with brick gate pillars at the road. A gatehouse/checkpoint exists but is not crisply resolved.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly identifiable staffed guard booth resolved in available imagery; large industrial gypsum plants often run gate/scale-house check-in. Marked remoteGs as the likelier read but both flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: Truck scale near the plant entrance is expected (inbound/outbound weighing of gypsum and board loads); not crisply confirmed in imagery.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Gypsum rock received by ship at the river wharf on the N edge; finished wallboard ships by truck/rail from the S/SW board-line building and storage yard — physically separate operations.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive trailer parking visible in the plant interior near the board lines; flatbed and dry-van trailers staged across the yard.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large multi-building campus: board-line plant, calcining/process buildings, river wharf, finished-goods storage yard, and ancillary buildings.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Truck loading is largely flatbed forklift-loading from storage rows; limited true dock-door bank. Estimated 0-10 doors.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spurs run into the property along the SW edge (confirmed in satellite); plant ships and receives by rail.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Savannah, GA metro industrial corridor on the river — Urban.
